findings.claim: The landmark_00_local_dx coordinate proxy is non-monotone over the full observed support [0.0,0.49]: it rises to a positive peak near the middle of the window, then falls to a negative trough, then partially recovers toward the endpoint. The whole-window mean z is slightly negative (-0.18), so the endpoint value is not representative of the window.

The observed-node linear trend for landmark_00_local_dx is strongly negative at the first node (first_rate_z=-17.49) and strongly positive at the last node (last_rate_z=8.11), with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches. This is a changing contrast, not a stationary target, and the polynomial fit was not accepted (polynomial_accepted=false, relative_node_RMSE=0.78).

The score clock is defined over observed score nodes 0.0 to 0.49 with learning window [0.0,0.5] and curve support [0.0,0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so no decoded final affinity label is available in this evidence.

hypotheses.direction: non-monotone; positive mid-window excursion followed by negative excursion and partial recovery
hypotheses.falsifier: If a re-read of the same curve over the same support shows no sign change in the deviation from the window mean, or if the first/last rate z-scores do not retain opposite signs, the contrast claim fails.
hypotheses.scope: global over observed score nodes [0.0,0.49]; no extrapolation
hypotheses.statement: A time-dependent coordinate contrast exists for landmark_00_local_dx: the signed deviation from the window mean changes sign within the observed window, so any reward term keyed to this coordinate should be evaluated as a function of score node rather than as a single endpoint target.

hypotheses.direction: opposite-signed rates; no single absolute target implied
hypotheses.falsifier: If an accepted polynomial or stable per-node profile shows a consistent single-signed trend with no strong sign conflicts, the no-stationary-target claim fails.
hypotheses.statement: Because the first-node and last-node rates have opposite signs and the polynomial fit is rejected, a stationary absolute coordinate target for landmark_00_local_dx is not supported by this evidence; only the changing contrast is supported.

limitations: Only one coordinate feature (landmark_00_local_dx) was read; the remaining 199 curve features were not queried, so no cross-feature or regional comparison is claimed.
Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; no stage boundary or phase knot is inferred from this evidence.

No decoded final affinity labels are present (recorded affinities removed, equal score prior), so selection preference here is association only and is not evidence of descendant survival or measured final benefit.
The coordinate proxy is untyped; no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation is attached.
The polynomial representation was not accepted and relative_node_RMSE is high, so the curve is treated as observed-node evidence only, without extrapolation.
